name: SweetWide
purpose: Grungy stereo widener built from ring-modulation ideas: exaggerates the side signal with a gnarly, compressed character. Also narrows the image when turned the other way. A secret-weapon colour effect, not a transparent widener.

expose.ai_hint: How the effect reacts to quiet sounds: 0 is mild, higher brings up grungy, compressed-sounding side content. Obvious above 0.7.
0.5 is no change. Above 0.5 widens, below 0.5 narrows (0 is the strongest narrowing). 0.6-0.75 is a typical widening.

notes: All Airwindows parameters are 0..1. Airwindopedia describes it as strange and grungy, suited to heavy guitar busses, synths and drum rooms, and not for full mixes.
CPU: 0.33% of one core at 48 kHz on Plugsalot's 2-core build machine (plugin/tests/TestMain.cpp); 1 point per 2%, minimum 1.
